headline: Concordia Irvine's fifteen goals buy only three wins
dek: Concordia Irvine lost at Cal State Dominguez Hills on Tuesday, their third defeat against three wins and a draw. Fifteen goals, more than any other programme has scored, have come from twelve different scorers; fourteen have gone in at the other end.
displaced_by: Hawai'i Pacific's draw at Menlo took their goals conceded to fifteen, level with Vanguard, so Vanguard no longer have the leakiest defence outright; Concordia Irvine's defeat at Cal State Dominguez Hills is the day's news.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Hawai'i Pacific have scored twelve goals from eight different scorers and won once, because they have conceded fifteen.

wire.line: Chaminade have lost all five matches they have played; no other programme is still without a point.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day; the Vanguard matches that do have a score have brought one win, one draw and four defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Hilo have lost three matches in a row after opening with three wins; the defeat at MSU Denver leaves them with five goals scored and five conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Point Loma stand level at two wins, two draws and two defeats, with nine goals scored and seven conceded, before Thursday's match at Vanguard.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Strickler has made thirty saves for Westmont and conceded eleven goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dominican (Calif.) have drawn three of their six matches and won none, scoring eight and conceding twelve.

last_match.line: Hawai'i Pacific have not won since beating Chaminade at home; Menlo had already beaten Jessup.

next_match.line: Vanguard's only win came at home; Point Loma have already drawn with Cal State Dominguez Hills, who beat Vanguard.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
